evidence_articles.content: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday said the State government's policy of 'zero tolerance' towards crime and criminals had restored law and order and created a sense of security, making it a preferred destination for industrial investments.

recent_articles.title: CM Adityanath launches Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam mega plantation campaign - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, launched a "**Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam**" mega plantation campaign on World Environment Day. The campaign, dedicated to mothers, aims to address environmental concerns by encouraging citizens to plant trees in their honor and contribute to forest conservation efforts.  Adityanath emphasized the need for collective action to protect the environment and highlighted simple measures like avoiding single-use plastic to prevent damage. He also urged citizens not to harm existing trees and to plant at least one tree on every important occasion, referencing the significant number of saplings planted in **Uttar Pradesh** over the past nine years.

recent_articles.title: Parimala and Co movie review: Jayaram, Urvashi’s comedy thriller is a lazy disaster | Movie-review News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parimala and Co**, a Tamil film directed by **Pandinraj**, is widely considered to be one of the worst recent releases in the Tamil film industry. The movie, which follows a whodunit plot, suffers from lazy writing, uninspired performances, and an overall lack of creativity.  The characters are underdeveloped and stereotypical, while the story meanders without tension or genuine humor. **Mysskin** delivers a strong performance as Inspector Emperuman, but it is not enough to save the film from its shortcomings.

recent_articles.title: 2027 UP Assembly Elections: Decoding UP's Political Battle: Can BJP Counter Akhilesh Yadav Samajwadi's PDA Formula?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The political landscape of Uttar Pradesh is shifting as parties prepare for the 2027 Assembly elections. The **Samajwadi Party** (SP) is attempting to broaden its appeal beyond the Muslim-Yadav base with a "PDA" formula targeting OBCs, Dalits, and minorities.  The **BJP**, meanwhile, is focusing on non-Yadav OBCs and other key social groups through strong leadership and Hindutva messaging. The SP's efforts are facing challenges from internal contradictions within the PDA coalition and concerns raised by leaders like **Om Prakash Rajbhar** of the SBSP who argue for greater representation within the party.  The BJP, with its focus on Hindu consolidation, is seen as having a structural advantage in this caste-based battle.

recent_articles.title: Noida Sector 74 Ivy County fire, Video: Massive Fire Erupts On 12th Floor Of High-Rise Building In Noida
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Firefighters** are battling two separate blazes in Noida, India. A massive fire broke out on the 12th floor of a residential building in Sector 74, while another fire occurred on the ground floor of a building in Sector 52.  No casualties have been reported in either incident. **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** directed officials to expedite relief and rescue operations. The cause of both fires remains unclear.

recent_articles.title: UP hikes remunerations of advocate general, other govt lawyers after more than 1o years | Legal News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Uttar Pradesh** Cabinet approved a proposal to increase the monthly retainership and appearance fees for lawyers representing the state government. The last revision was over 10 years ago, according to a senior official.  The decision was made during a meeting led by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and involved the state Law Department.  The revised fees apply to various categories of legal professionals including the advocate general, chief standing counsels, and district government counsels.

recent_articles.title: Congress Rahul Gandhi Priyanka Gandhi: With Eye On Upcoming Polls, Congress Plans Major Organisational Reshuffle
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the appointment of DK Shivakumar as Chief Minister of Karnataka, **BK Hariprasad** has been named the state Congress president.  The Congress is planning a major reshuffle across over six states, with a focus on poll-bound regions like Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa, Manipur, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh. The party is considering replacing in-charges and state presidents to attract voters and balance caste dynamics. This reshuffle is expected to be the last major one under **Mallikarjun Kharge**'s leadership as Congress president.

recent_articles.title: ‘Cow not animal, it’s revered as mother’: Yogi Adityanath asks clerics to caution followers against any disrespect | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh**, criticized those who disrespect cows, demanding that Muslim clerics caution their followers against such behavior. He also addressed recent incidents of violence and religious persecution, accusing some religious leaders of double standards for not speaking out on behalf of victims displaced by Partition.  He praised Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Home Minister **Amit Shah** for the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) and criticized opposition parties for opposing it while accusing them of supporting illegal infiltration. He distributed land ownership certificates to families displaced from Pakistan, highlighting their struggle against religious extremism.

recent_articles.title: UP records 90% attendance in B Ed entrance exam; over 4.44 lakh candidates appear | Education News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **B.Ed Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) 2026** was successfully conducted in Uttar Pradesh on Sunday, with 90% of the 4,44,958 registered candidates participating. The exam, overseen by **Bundelkhand University**, took place at 1,011 centers across 72 districts and utilized advanced technology including AI-based face recognition, fingerprint verification, and real-time attendance systems to ensure fairness.  **Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Minister Yogendra Upadhyay** expressed satisfaction with the exam's successful conduct and highlighted the government's commitment to transparent and secure examinations.

recent_articles.title: UP records 90% attendance in B Ed entrance exam; over 4.44 lakh candidates appear | Education News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **B.Ed Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) 2026** was successfully conducted in Uttar Pradesh on Sunday, with 90% of the 4,44,958 registered candidates participating.  **Yogendra Upadhyay**, **Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Minister**, expressed satisfaction over the exam's fairness and transparency, which were enhanced by advanced technology including AI-based face recognition, fingerprint verification, and real-time attendance systems. The examination was overseen by a centralized command center with 22,000 CCTV cameras and 5,651 biometric machines to ensure only genuine candidates took the test.

recent_articles.title: Adityanath urges people to protect nature, links environmental conservation to Sanatan traditions
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, urged citizens to actively participate in environmental conservation, emphasizing its deep connection to Indian culture and tradition. He highlighted the importance of respecting nature through rituals like Vat Savitri fast and festivals like Chhath and Mahakumbh.  Adityanath stressed the need for collective action on World Environment Day, urging people to pledge themselves to protecting nature and conserving resources. The state government has been actively involved in environmental initiatives such as the inclusion of Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary and the "One District One River" program.

recent_articles.title: UP gets full-time DGP after four years, Rajeev Krishna takes charge | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Yogi Adityanath**-led government in Uttar Pradesh appointed Rajeev Krishna as full-time director general of police (DGP), two days after receiving a panel of names from the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**.  This appointment comes after five IPS officers served as acting DGP since 2022, following the removal of Mukul Goel on charges of inefficiency. Krishna has held various positions in the state police and has experience with central deputation, including heading the BSF's Jammu frontier. He was also the first head of the Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) when it was established in 2008.

recent_articles.title: UP gets full-time DGP after four years, Rajeev Krishna takes charge | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajeev Krishna**, a 1991-batch IPS officer, has been appointed as the full-time director general of police (DGP) in **Uttar Pradesh**.  The appointment comes after five acting DGPs served since **Mukul Goel** was removed from the post in 2022. The decision was made following a panel recommendation by the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** and approval from **Sanjay Prasad**, Additional Chief Secretary (Home). Krishna has held various positions within the state police, including head of the Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorist Squad and BSF's Jammu frontier.

recent_articles.title: Our naval might confined Pakistan to its ports: Rajnath Singh | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** and **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** inaugurated the naval museum 'Nausena Shaurya Vatika' in Lucknow. The open-air display showcases artifacts and weapon systems of INS Gomati, decommissioned in 2022 after 34 years of service.  **Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi**, **Chief of the Naval Staff**, also attended the event.  **Singh** highlighted the Indian Navy's role in securing maritime routes and its contribution to Operation Sindoor, which confined the Pakistan Navy to its ports. He emphasized India's growing self-reliance in defense production through initiatives like Make-in-India.

recent_articles.title: ‘Reminder of true cost of nation’s security’: Rajnath, Yogi inaugurate naval museum in Lucknow | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** and **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** inaugurated the 'Nausena Shaurya Vatika' naval museum in Lucknow. The open-air display showcases artifacts from INS Gomati, a decommissioned ship that served for 34 years.  The museum cost Rs 19 crore to build and features weapons systems, including an AK 726 naval gun and a TU 142M maritime patrol aircraft. **Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi**, Chief of the Naval Staff, was also present at the inauguration. The museum aims to inspire future generations about India's defense capabilities.

recent_articles.title: Indian Navy confined entire Pak Navy to its ports during Operation Sindoor: Rajnath
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** addressed the inauguration of the 'Nausena Shaurya Vatika', an open-air naval museum in Lucknow, highlighting the Indian Navy's role in Operation Sindoor.  The operation, launched to avenge the Pahalgam terror attack, saw **Indian Navy Chief Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi**, and deputy chief ministers Brajesh Pathak and Keshav Prasad Maurya also present. The museum showcases the legacy, operational capabilities, and maritime achievements of the Indian Navy. Singh emphasized that maritime security is vital for India's economy and that the navy plays a crucial role in safeguarding national interests.  The museum was developed jointly by the **Indian Navy** and the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Department.

recent_articles.title: Short: Indian Navy confined entire Pak Navy to its ports during Operation Sindoor: Rajnath
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** inaugurated the 'Nausena Shaurya Vatika', an open-air naval museum in Lucknow, highlighting India's maritime security and advancements in defence manufacturing. The museum showcases the Indian Navy's legacy, operational capabilities, and achievements, including the decommissioned warship INS Gomati. **Singh** emphasized the importance of maritime security for national well-being and praised Uttar Pradesh's economic growth under Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath.  The museum aims to inspire future generations and educate the public about the value of freedom and security.

recent_articles.title: Defence Minister inaugurates ‘Nausena Shaurya Vatika’ in Lucknow - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajnath Singh**, **Yogi Adityanath**, and others jointly inaugurated the ‘Nausena Shaurya Vatika’, an open-air naval museum in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.  The museum is a second phase of the Nausena Shaurya Sangrahalaya, showcasing the Indian Navy's history and valor. **Singh** praised the Navy's role in Operation Sindoor, highlighting its pressure on Pakistan during the operation. He also commended the progress of Uttar Pradesh under **Adityanath**, attributing it to strong law and order and a shift from "goonda raj" to a focus on development and investment.

recent_articles.title: Hamirpur bridge collapse: Case lodged against executing agency, contractor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** have registered a case against the executing agency and contractor of the Betwa river bridge in Hamirpur, accusing them of negligence and laxity. The case was filed by **State Bridge Corporation Deputy Project Manager Dilip Kumar**, who accused owner **Pawan Pratap Singh** and contractor **Nitish Kumar**. One assistant engineer has been suspended for negligence.  The incident occurred during a severe storm when a slab collapsed, killing six labourers and injuring three others while they were sleeping on the upper portion of the bridge.

recent_articles.title: Six killed and 21 injured as bus overturns on Lucknow-Agra Expressway - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **double-decker AC bus** carrying approximately 50 passengers overturned on the Lucknow-Agra Expressway in Unnao district, Uttar Pradesh, killing six people including a police sub-inspector.  The incident occurred at 5:15 am when the bus reportedly lost control after the driver fell asleep at the wheel. The bus collided with the divider and overturned, ejecting several passengers through the windows. **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** expressed condolences to the families of the deceased and wished for a speedy recovery for the injured.

recent_articles.title: Scorching days, restless nights: Heatwave tightens grip across parts of India - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** experienced scorching temperatures exceeding 44° Celsius in several regions, prompting **hospitals** in Punjab to activate heat stroke management units. The **IMD** issued heatwave alerts for three districts of Jharkhand and warned of rising temperatures across Delhi, Haryana, and Chandigarh.  Veterinarians and animal rescuers reported an increase in distressed birds and animals suffering from dehydration and heatstroke. In Himachal Pradesh, a yellow warning for heatwave conditions was issued for parts of the state. **Chief Ministers** of various states ordered officials to ensure adequate drinking water availability, while **Congress leader Kishori Lal Sharma** raised concerns about power supply disruptions in Uttar Pradesh's Amethi constituency.

recent_articles.title: Public outcry grows louder over power cuts in U.P.; Oppn. parties call it structural failure - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** of Uttar Pradesh are protesting frequent power cuts, exacerbated by the heat wave. **Opposition parties**, including the Samajwadi Party and Congress, have criticized the **Yogi Adityanath-led government** for its handling of the crisis, alleging a failure to expand power generation capacity and pointing to structural issues within the electricity department. The **Vidyut Karmchari Joint Sangharsh Samiti** has also blamed the vertical restructuring system implemented in the power corporation for the ongoing problems.

recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following a powerful storm that killed at least 111 people in Uttar Pradesh, the **Uttar Pradesh** government directed Ministers to assess the situation and provide financial assistance. The **Congress** party criticized the **Union Government's** lack of response, highlighting the condolences from Russian President Vladimir Putin as evidence of their insensitivity.  The **Uttar Pradesh** Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced a ₹4 lakh compensation for families who lost loved ones and directed officials to ensure relief for farmers and livestock owners.

recent_articles.title: Unseasonal storms leave 111 dead in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 111 people were killed and hundreds more injured in **Uttar Pradesh** after a powerful storm brought heavy rain, strong winds, and thunderstorms.  The **U.P. Relief Commissioner’s office** reported damage to homes, trees, and electric poles across 26 districts. **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** directed officials to provide aid to victims and release compensation. **Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav** called for comprehensive relief efforts and urged the government to assess losses and ensure insurance payments.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: Prateek Yadav, Mulayam Singh Yadav’s younger son, passes away in Lucknow - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prateek Yadav**, the son of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister **Mulayam Singh Yadav** and husband of BJP leader **Aparna Bisht Yadav**, passed away on Wednesday morning at the age of 38.  He was pronounced dead after being rushed to a hospital in Lucknow where doctors could not determine the cause of death.  **Yogi Adityanath**, the current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, expressed condolences and offered prayers for the departed soul.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet expanded with six new Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, expanded his state cabinet by adding six new ministers and elevating two to independent charge.  **Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary** and **Manoj Kumar Pandey** were sworn in as Cabinet Ministers, while **Chaudhary** previously served as State BJP president and **Pandey** switched from the Samajwadi Party (SP) before the 2024 Lok Sabha election.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Cabinet 2026: From Dilip Ghosh to Agnimitra Paul, Ministers who were sworn in along with Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, newly sworn in as the Chief Minister of West Bengal, inducted five new ministers into his cabinet on Saturday. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, J. P. Nadda, and Dharmendra Pradhan**, among other BJP leaders.  **Dilip Ghosh**, a senior BJP leader who secured victory in the Kharagpur seat, **Agnimitra Paul**, a fashion designer-turned-legislator who won Asansol Dakshin, **Ashok Kirtania**, a BJP stalwart who gained victory in Bangaon Uttar, and **Kshudiram Tudu**, a former school teacher from Ranibandh (ST) constituency, were among the newly appointed ministers.  **Nisith Pramanik**, a key face of BJP from North Bengal, was also inducted into the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh government scraps smart prepaid meter system; shifts all consumers to postpaid mode - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Uttar Pradesh** government has decided to discontinue the smart prepaid electricity meter system and convert all existing devices to postpaid mode.  **Energy Minister A.K. Sharma** announced this decision, citing consumer convenience and grievances following growing protests over alleged billing irregularities. The new arrangement will see consumers receive bills after consumption, with bills for May 2026 issued in June. **Central Electricity Regulatory Commission Advisory Committee member Avadhesh Kumar Verma**, who represents the Uttar Pradesh Rajya Vidyut Upbhokta Parishad, welcomed the decision but criticized the delay and alleged that the state government was pressured by the central regulatory body into taking action.

recent_articles.title: Yogi Adityanath launches first phase of Census 2027 in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister**, launched the first phase of Census-2027, a digital census aimed at supporting data-driven planning and welfare delivery. The exercise, running from May 7 to May 21, allows citizens to self-enumerate online before enumerators begin door-to-door verification across **Uttar Pradesh**.  The second phase will involve individual enumeration and caste enumeration, including coverage of forest villages for the first time.  **Adityanath** emphasized the importance of accurate census data for improving infrastructure, education, healthcare, social security, and welfare schemes.

recent_articles.title: How ‘bulldozer justice’ undermines the law - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A five-year-old girl gifted a bulldozer toy to **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, sparking concerns about the normalization of "bulldozer justice" and its potential influence on impressionable minds.  **Adityanath** returned the gift and advised the child to focus on her studies, but the incident highlights the public's acceptance of this political symbol and its implications for extrajudicial action within the state.

recent_articles.title: Strict action against anyone forcibly occupying others' land: Yogi Adityanath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, addressed citizens during a 'janata darshan' program at the Gorakhnath temple in Gorakhpur. He assured residents that his government would effectively address their concerns, including illegal land grabbing, and instructed officials to take legal action against perpetrators.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal: Modi's BJP conquers one of India's toughest political frontiers
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won a decisive victory in West Bengal, marking a significant breakthrough for **Narendra Modi** and his 12-year reign.  This unexpected outcome comes after years of the party's struggle to gain traction in the state, which has traditionally been dominated by the Trinamool Congress (TMC). The BJP's success is attributed to a combination of factors, including its aggressive welfare pitch, sharpened Hindu consolidation efforts, and a focus on alleged corruption within the TMC. This victory will likely have far-reaching implications for the BJP's future trajectory, potentially solidifying **Amit Shah**'s position as Modi's successor.

recent_articles.title: U.P. CM announces wage reform, warns industrial unrest will harm progress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, announced the formation of a new wage board to ensure equitable wages for workers, particularly those in industries with 10 or more employees. He emphasized the interdependence of industry and labor, stating that both must thrive for mutual success.  **Adityanath** also revealed plans to provide free annual health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh to workers in industrial regions through collaboration with insurance companies and entrepreneurs.

recent_articles.title: ‘Victim is Dalit, poor every time’: Rahul Gandhi demands probe into Ghazipur rape-murder - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, and the **Congress party** are demanding a high-level investigation into the alleged rape and murder of a girl from the Vishwakarma community in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur district. **Gandhi** criticized the government for its inaction and demanded immediate justice, protection for the victim's family, and action against police officers involved.  He also questioned Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Chief Minister **Yogi Adityanath**, asking why their rule has made daughters unsafe.

recent_articles.title: Feeling gloomy about the economy? The ‘vibecession’ has arrived in Australia – but experts are less worried | Australian economy | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Australian** households are experiencing heightened anxiety due to rising inflation and the potential for a recession, according to a poll. However, economists remain optimistic, predicting a 20% chance of a recession within the next year. While **Belinda Allen**, head of Australian economics at the Commonwealth Bank, notes that consumer spending is holding up despite some weakness in travel and accommodation, **Gareth Spence**, head of Australian economics at National Australia Bank, acknowledges a potential downturn but believes it will not be a full-blown recession.  Experts are concerned about the impact of the Iran war on oil prices and supply chains, with EY modeling a worst-case scenario that could lead to significant economic disruption. Despite these concerns, economists remain optimistic about the Australian economy's resilience in the coming year.

recent_articles.title: Yogi leads march against Opposition; Akhilesh predicts U.P. poll defeat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** in Uttar Pradesh held a protest march against the **Congress** and **Samajwadi Party** for voting against the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026. The bill aimed to redistribute Lok Sabha seats based on the 2011 Census to expedite the implementation of women's reservation.  **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister, led the march and criticized the opposition parties for opposing women's rights. **Akhilesh Yadav**, the Samajwadi Party president, called the protest a "practice" before the BJP could become the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: Noida protests: Workers in India demand hike in minimum wage - but it's not as simple
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Thousands of factory workers in Noida, India, have been protesting for higher wages and improved working conditions. The protests, which began a week ago as mostly peaceful demonstrations, have escalated into violent clashes with police using tear gas and making arrests.  **Uttar Pradesh**'s government has announced temporary wage increases but many workers feel these are insufficient. Experts point to inconsistent enforcement of labor laws and the lack of union representation in many sectors as contributing factors to the growing discontent. The protests highlight a broader struggle for fair pay within India's vast informal sector, where wages have not kept pace with rising living costs.

recent_articles.title: Top U.P. Leaders paid tribute to B.R. Ambedkar on birth anniversary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, paid tributes to B.R. Ambedkar on his birth anniversary in Lucknow, offering flowers at a statue and participating in a function that included the release of a souvenir titled “Bharat Bhagya Vidhata.” The event also marked the launch of the "Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme," which aims to beautify and conserve statues of Ambedkar throughout the state.

recent_articles.title: 10 dead as boat with devotees capsizes in Mathura - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **boat** carrying devotees from Punjab capsized in the Yamuna river near Mathura, Uttar Pradesh on Friday (April 10, 2026), resulting in at least 10 deaths and several injuries. The incident occurred after the boat collided with an iron pontoon bridge, causing it to overturn. Rescue operations are underway by **NDRF**, **SDRF**, local divers, and fire service teams, while officials from both **Punjab** and **Uttar Pradesh** have offered condolences and pledged assistance.

recent_articles.title: BJP, the known unknown in Kerala 2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The BJP's emergence in Kerala has significantly altered the political landscape, with traditional rivals, the Congress-led UDF and CPI-M-led LDF, aligning their campaigns against each other. The BJP claims a false fight between the two parties while emphasizing its stance on the Sabarimala issue.  While the BJP seeks to capitalize on Hindu sentiment in Kerala, the UDF faces challenges from internal divisions within its Christian and Muslim communities.  The LDF has abandoned its previous stance on women's entry into the Sabarimala shrine, aligning with the BJP's position. The outcome of these elections remains uncertain due to a complex interplay of religious affiliations, demographic shifts, and political maneuvering.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election 2026: Curtains down on high-voltage campaign - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Assam Assembly elections concluded on April 7, with voters casting their ballots for the state's 126 seats. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and other BJP leaders campaigned against the opposition Congress, accusing it of promoting infiltrators and failing to address development issues. The Congress countered by highlighting corruption allegations against the ruling party and promising justice for singer Zubeen Garg if elected. Prominent candidates include Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, Gaurav Gogoi (Congress), Badruddin Ajmal (AIUDF), and Debabrata Saikia (opposition).  The elections will be held in a single phase on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: U.P. CM Yogi Adityanath pushes for zero dropout, appeals to society for ensuring no child is left out of school - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, launched a new campaign called “School Chalo Abhiyan” to reduce school dropout rates. He emphasized that every child should be educated and encouraged parents, teachers, and public representatives to ensure this goal is achieved.  The campaign aims to bring down the dropout rate from 3% to zero by providing free facilities and uniforms for all students. **Adityanath** also highlighted the significant investment in school education, including expansion of **Kasturba Gandhi schools** and establishment of **Atal Residential Schools**.

recent_articles.title: In poll-bound Assam, Adityanath stresses U.P. model of dealing with rioters - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister**, addressed an election rally in Assam, comparing "rioters" and "infiltrators" to highlight his stance on law and order. He asserted that only the **BJP-led NDA** can prevent demographic change in Assam, claiming that the Congress has weakened the state's security and social fabric by encouraging infiltration and violence. Adityanath criticized the **Congress** and **AIUDF**, accusing them of working together to compromise Assam's culture and heritage. He promised a BJP-led government would ensure stability and crack down on illegal entrants, while also emphasizing development and cultural preservation.

recent_articles.title: Over 17,000 factories registered in nine years of Yogi rule, shows data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Uttar Pradesh** government announced that 17,841 new factories have been registered in the state since April 2017 under the leadership of **Yogi Adityanath**. This represents a significant increase from the previous period and indicates an industrial revolution with over 16 lakh people gaining employment. The government attributes this growth to improved ease of doing business, investor-friendly policies, and strong infrastructure development across all regions.

recent_articles.title: Enemies of the ‘Ambedkar Constitution’ have to be routed in the polls: Akhilesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, president of the **Samajwadi Party**, launched his campaign for the 2027 Assembly elections in Western Uttar Pradesh, emphasizing the "suffering" experienced by backward classes (PDA) and accusing the BJP of divisive politics. recent_articles.title: Parties, outfits invoke ‘Brahmin’ angle to ‘pandit’ reference in U.P. police recruitment exam - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
The **Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board** faced criticism after a question in the written test for sub-inspector (civil police) and equivalent posts sparked controversy. The question asked candidates to choose a term for "a person who changes according to circumstances," with options including "Pandit" (scholar), "Avsarvadi" (opportunist), "Nishkapat" (innocent or sincere), and "Sadachari" (virtuous).  The use of the word "Pandit" in this context, which is also used to refer to Brahmins, led to accusations that the question was designed to portray the community in a derogatory way.

Political parties, including the **Congress** party and the **Sarv Brahmin Ekta Sabha**, condemned the question as discriminatory and disrespectful. The Deputy Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, **Brajesh Pathak**, stated that the government took the issue seriously and would ensure no such remarks are made about any community's dignity or beliefs.  The controversy escalated when **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** issued directives to all recruitment board chairpersons, instructing them to prevent disrespectful language towards any individual, caste, sect, or religious community. He also directed that paper setters be blacklisted for using such language and included this provision in the MoU with paper setters.

The ruling **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** condemned the incident, emphasizing that those engaging in divisive tactics would face legal consequences. The BJP asserted that such actions threaten social harmony and undermine national unity.
